test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid credentials
test_cases.expected_result: authenticates and redirects to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with empty Username
steps: 2. Fill the Password field with <valid password>
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Username is required.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with empty Password
steps: 1. Fill the Username field with <valid username>
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Password is required.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with invalid credentials
steps: 1. Fill the Username field with <invalid username>
2. Fill the Password field with <invalid password>
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with locked out user
steps: 1. Fill the Username field with locked_out_user
2. Fill the Password field with secret_sauce
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with empty Username
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Username is required.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with empty Password
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Password is required.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with invalid credentials
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with locked out user
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.

test_cases.test_case: Enter long text in Username field
steps: 1. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating the Username is too long or it accepts the input with truncation.

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in Password field
steps: 2. Enter special characters '!@#$%^&*()' in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating invalid password or it accepts the input.

test_cases.test_case: View Product Detail from Product Inventory
steps: 1. Click on a product name or image in the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: opens Product Detail page

test_cases.test_case: Add item to cart from Product Inventory
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' button for a product in the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: adds item to cart; button changes to 'Remove'; cart badge count increments

test_cases.test_case: Remove item from cart in Product Inventory
preconditions: Item is already in the cart
steps: 1. Click 'Remove' button for the item in the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: removes item from cart; button changes to 'Add to cart'; cart badge count decrements

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Name A–Z
steps: 1. Select 'Name A–Z' from the Sort_By dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in alphabetical order from A to Z

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Price low–high
steps: 1. Select 'Price low–high' from the Sort_By dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in ascending order by price

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add a product to cart without being logged in
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click 'Add to cart' on any product
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add the same product to cart multiple times
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' on a product
2. Click 'Add to cart' on the same product again
test_cases.expected_result: Cart badge count does not increment beyond 1; error message displayed indicating product is already in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove a product from cart when it is not in the cart
steps: 1. Click 'Remove' on a product that is not in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed indicating product is not in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Rapid add to cart and remove actions
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' for a product
2. Immediately click 'Remove' for the same product
test_cases.expected_result: Cart badge count decrements by 1; button changes back to 'Add to cart'

test_cases.test_case: View product detail after rapid actions
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' for a product
2. Click 'View Product Detail' for the same product
test_cases.expected_result: Product Detail page opens without any error; cart remains unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Sort dropdown edge cases
steps: 1. Select 'Name A–Z' from the Sort By dropdown
2. Select 'Name Z–A' from the Sort By dropdown
3. Select 'Price low–high' from the Sort By dropdown
4. Select 'Price high–low' from the Sort By dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Product list updates correctly for each sorting option without any errors

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart
preconditions: Product is currently not in cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product added to cart

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product removed from cart

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to products
test_cases.expected_result: Returned to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Go to Shopping Cart
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add product to cart when it is already in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; 'Add to cart' button is not available in the current state.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove product from cart when it is not in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; 'Remove' button is not available in the current state.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate back to products
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Product Inventory page.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to go to shopping cart
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Shopping Cart.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive state transitions after adding to cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product is removed from cart; state changes to Not_In_Cart

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive state transitions after removing from cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product is added to cart; state changes to In_Cart

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to products after adding to cart
test_cases.expected_result: Returned to Product Inventory page; product state remains In_Cart

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to Shopping Cart after adding product
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Shopping Cart; product is listed in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Remove an item from the cart
preconditions: Cart contains at least one item
steps: 1. Click the 'Remove' button next to an item in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Item removed from cart

test_cases.test_case: Continue shopping
test_cases.expected_result: returns to Product Inventory

test_cases.test_case: Begin checkout
test_cases.expected_result: begins checkout

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove an item from the cart when the cart is empty
steps: 1. Ensure the shopping cart is empty
2. Click the 'Remove' button for an item
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; the cart remains empty and no items are removed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to continue shopping when no items are in the cart
steps: 1. Ensure the shopping cart is empty
test_cases.expected_result: Remains on the Shopping Cart page; no navigation occurs

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to checkout when the cart is empty
steps: 1. Ensure the shopping cart is empty
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; remains on the Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly remove items from the cart
preconditions: User has multiple items in the cart
steps: 2. Immediately click 'Remove' on the second item
test_cases.expected_result: Both items are removed from the cart; the cart updates correctly without errors.

test_cases.test_case: Return to Product Inventory after adding items
preconditions: User has items in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Product Inventory; cart remains unchanged.

test_cases.test_case: Checkout with items in the cart
preconditions: User has items in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is directed to the checkout process; items from the cart are retained.

test_cases.test_case: Submit Checkout Form with valid information
steps: 1. Enter <valid first name> in the First Name field
2. Enter <valid last name> in the Last Name field
3. Enter <valid zip/postal code> in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: User proceeds to the overview step

test_cases.test_case: Cancel Checkout Form
test_cases.expected_result: User returns to the Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Leave First Name blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the First Name field blank
2. Fill Last Name and Zip/Postal Code with valid values
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the First Name field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave Last Name blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the Last Name field blank
2. Fill First Name and Zip/Postal Code with valid values
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Last Name field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave Zip/Postal Code blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the Zip/Postal Code field blank
2. Fill First Name and Last Name with valid values
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Zip/Postal Code field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave all required fields blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code fields blank
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the First Name field indicating it is required; Inline validation error appears on the Last Name field indicating it is required; Inline validation error appears on the Zip/Postal Code field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with First Name empty
steps: 1. Leave the First Name field empty
2. Fill Last Name with valid data
3. Fill Zip/Postal Code with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: First Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with Last Name empty
steps: 1. Fill First Name with valid data
2. Leave the Last Name field empty
3. Fill Zip/Postal Code with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Last Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with Zip/Postal Code empty
steps: 1. Fill First Name with valid data
2. Fill Last Name with valid data
3. Leave the Zip/Postal Code field empty
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Postal Code is required'

test_cases.test_case: Click Cancel after filling some fields
steps: 1. Fill First Name with valid data
2. Fill Last Name with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: User is returned to the Shopping Cart without any data saved

test_cases.test_case: Finish the order successfully
test_cases.expected_result: completes the order and navigates to the confirmation page

test_cases.test_case: Cancel the checkout successfully
test_cases.expected_result: exits checkout

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish the order without any payment information
steps: 1. Leave the Payment Information section blank
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; error shown indicating Payment Information is required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to cancel the checkout without any prior action
test_cases.expected_result: Exits checkout without any changes made to the order

test_cases.test_case: Rapid re-submission after redirect
preconditions: User has valid payment and shipping information
steps: 1. Click the Finish button to complete the order
2. Press the browser back button immediately after the confirmation page loads
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the checkout overview step without the order being duplicated

test_cases.test_case: Cancel checkout and verify exit behavior
preconditions: User is on the checkout overview step
test_cases.expected_result: User is exited from the checkout process and returns to the previous page

test_cases.test_case: User views confirmation message and returns to product inventory
test_cases.expected_result: The page shows 'Thank you for your order!' and returns to Product Inventory and clears the cart

test_cases.test_case: User clicks Back Home button
test_cases.expected_result: returns to Product Inventory and clears the cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to click 'Back Home' without any prior action
test_cases.expected_result: The page remains on the Confirmation Page; no transition occurs; the cart is not cleared.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid re-submission after redirect
preconditions: User has successfully completed the checkout process
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Product Inventory; the cart is cleared and the confirmation page is not pre-filled

test_cases.test_case: User successfully logs out
test_cases.expected_result: ends the session and returns the user to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to logout while not logged in
preconditions: user must not be logged in
steps: 1. Ensure the user is not logged in
test_cases.expected_result: Logout action is not performed; user remains on the current page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log out when already logged out
test_cases.expected_result: Logout button is disabled or does not respond to the click

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive logout attempts
steps: 2. Immediately click the Logout button again
test_cases.expected_result: Second logout attempt is ignored; user is redirected to the login page only once

test_cases.test_case: Reset App State successfully clears the cart and resets in-app state
test_cases.expected_result: clears the cart, resets in-app state, including cart badge and add/remove button states

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to reset app state without any preconditions
steps: 1. Click on the Reset App State button
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; the app state remains unchanged.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive state transitions after reset
preconditions: User is logged in and has items in the cart
steps: 1. Click the Reset App State button
2. Immediately click the Reset App State button again
test_cases.expected_result: Second reset action is blocked; a message indicates that the state is already reset
